trans-unit.id: App Analytics staat aan. Apple maakt de eerste rapporten binnen 1 à 2 dagen klaar. Kom morgen terug of trek omlaag om te verversen.
trans-unit.source: App Analytics is on. Apple prepares the first reports within 1–2 days. Come back tomorrow or pull down to refresh.

trans-unit.target: App Review, ready for release and what needs attention at a glance.

trans-unit.id: Apple heeft de rapporten gestopt omdat ze lang niet zijn opgehaald. Schakel opnieuw in.
trans-unit.source: Apple stopped the reports because they haven't been fetched for a long time. Turn them on again.
trans-unit.target: Apple stopped the reports because they haven't been fetched for a long time. Turn them on again.

trans-unit.id: Apple levert App Analytics als dagrapporten met 2 tot 5 dagen vertraging. Sessies, installaties en crashes tellen alleen mee als minstens 5 gebruikers hebben ingestemd met het delen van analysegegevens. Apple heeft geen retentierapport: retentie is hier een benadering op basis van sessies van nieuwe gebruikers.
trans-unit.source: Apple delivers App Analytics as daily reports with a delay of 2 to 5 days. Sessions, installations and crashes only count if at least 5 users have agreed to share analytics data. Apple has no retention report: retention here is an approximation based on sessions from new users.
trans-unit.target: Apple delivers App Analytics as daily reports with a delay of 2 to 5 days. Sessions, installations and crashes only count if at least 5 users have agreed to share analytics data. Apple has no retention report: retention here is an approximation based on sessions from new users.

trans-unit.id: Apple levert verkoopcijfers ongeveer een dag later; de cijfers van vandaag zie je morgen.
trans-unit.source: Apple delivers sales figures about a day later; you'll see today's numbers tomorrow.
trans-unit.target: Apple delivers sales figures about a day later; you'll see today's numbers tomorrow.

trans-unit.id: Apple maakt de codes in de achtergrond; het kan even duren voordat je ze kunt downloaden.
trans-unit.source: Apple creates the codes in the background; it may take a while before you can download them.
trans-unit.target: Apple creates the codes in the background; it may take a while before you can download them.

trans-unit.id: Apple neemt de teksten van de vorige versie over. Daarna vul je What's New in, kies je een build en dien je in.
trans-unit.source: Apple copies the texts from the previous version. Then fill in What's New, choose a build and submit.
trans-unit.target: Apple copies the texts from the previous version. Then fill in What's New, choose a build and submit.

trans-unit.source: Apple automatically converts prices in other countries from your base country, unless you set them manually in App Store Connect.
trans-unit.target: Apple automatically converts prices in other countries from your base country, unless you set them manually in App Store Connect.

trans-unit.id: Apple stuurt bij elke gekozen gebeurtenis een ondertekend bericht naar de URL, bijvoorbeeld naar Homey, Slack of je eigen server.
trans-unit.source: For every selected event, Apple sends a signed message to the URL, for example to Homey, Slack or your own server.
trans-unit.target: For every selected event, Apple sends a signed message to the URL, for example to Homey, Slack or your own server.

trans-unit.id: Apps die met dit certificaat zijn ondertekend kunnen niet meer worden geïnstalleerd voor ontwikkeling. Dit kan niet ongedaan gemaakt worden.

trans-unit.target: Apps signed with this certificate can no longer be installed for development. This can't be undone.

trans-unit.target: DevTools sets up a webhook in App Store Connect for each app that points to the DevTools push server. It verifies Apple's signature and sends the notification to this device via OneSignal. Nothing is stored; your API key never leaves this device.

trans-unit.target: Promo codes in App Store Connect
